meta.title: Best travel seasons for Indian travellers, by country and region

rating_scale.best: Most reliable weather per the cited met service or tourism board
rating_scale.okay: Visitable, with trade-offs (heat, showers, cold, crowds)
rating_scale.avoid: Monsoon, storm, extreme heat or disruption months. Not a ban; low season, and often cheaper

meta.method: Seasons come from national met services and tourism boards (sources). Our 2016-2025 ERA5 averages (climate_normals.json) were used to split best from okay where sources give broad windows. Ratings that rely on that split are editorial judgement; review them before publishing.

india_peak_periods.name: Diwali week
india_peak_periods.dates: 8 Nov 2026 (Diwali, GoI list); 2027 falls in late Oct (Singapore lists Deepavali 28 Oct 2027) - confirm India's 2027 list when published
india_peak_periods.effect: Short-haul international fares spike; Dubai and Singapore routes 'commanding premium fares' and outbound sales to Dubai, Bali, Bangkok, Singapore, Vietnam up 30-40% vs Diwali 2024 (Moneycontrol, Oct 2025, quoting OTAs)

india_peak_periods.name: Indian summer school holidays
india_peak_periods.dates: Mid-May to end-June (e.g. Delhi govt schools 11 May-30 Jun 2026); varies by state/board
india_peak_periods.effect: Family travel peak from India. Clashes with SW monsoon in Sri Lanka west coast, Maldives, Andaman coast of Thailand, Nepal, Bhutan; and with heat in UAE. Good fit for Bali, east-coast Sri Lanka, Singapore, Vietnam's central coast.

india_peak_periods.name: Christmas-New Year
india_peak_periods.effect: [Inference] Global peak; overlaps Dubai Shopping Festival and Japan's New Year closures.

regions.name: Bangkok & Central
regions.avoid: Sep (wettest month in our 2016-2025 data, 254 mm)
regions.reason: TMD: cool season mid-Oct to mid-Feb under the dry NE monsoon; hot season mid-Feb to mid-May (Apr avg high 35 C in our data); rainy season mid-May to mid-Oct.

regions.name: Andaman coast (Phuket, Krabi)
regions.avoid: May-Oct (SW monsoon; 248-340 mm/month in our data)
regions.reason: TMD: SW monsoon (mid-May to mid-Oct) is rainier on coasts and mountain ranges; Phuket driest Jan-Mar in our data.

regions.name: North (Chiang Mai)
regions.avoid: Aug-Sep (wettest, 232-244 mm)
regions.reason: TMD: north and northeast turn 'quite cool' in the NE monsoon; Apr is hottest (avg high 36 C in our data).

countries.notes: Gulf islands (Koh Samui) differ: TMD says the south, especially the east side, stays rainy into December. Songkran (13-15 Apr) is Thai New Year [check TAT for events].
peaks: Diwali and Christmas-New Year fall in Thailand's best season, so expect peak pricing (see india_peak_periods).

regions.name: Singapore
regions.best: Feb-Mar, Jun-Sep (lowest monthly rain at Changi)
regions.avoid: None (year-round city); Nov-Jan is wettest
regions.reason: MSS: no distinct dry season; wettest Nov-Jan (NE monsoon wet phase, 252-332 mm), driest Feb (105 mm); Apr-May afternoons often >32 C; Jun-Sep can bring slight-to-moderate haze.

countries.notes: Rated on MSS 1991-2020 station normals, not ERA5.
peaks: Chinese New Year 6-7 Feb 2027 (MOM); Hari Raya Puasa 10 Mar 2027; Deepavali 28 Oct 2027 (Little India).

regions.name: Dubai & Abu Dhabi
regions.avoid: May-Sep (avg highs 38-42 C in our data)
regions.reason: Dubai Media Office: summer avg high ~41.8 C, lows ~29.7 C; winter avg high 23 C, low 14 C; most rain Jan-Mar but annual total only ~87 mm.

countries.notes: [Inference] Summer heat often means lower hotel rates and indoor attractions; check prices in the budget tool before recommending.
peaks: Ramadan expected to start ~8 Feb 2027 (astronomical estimate; confirmed by moon sighting).

regions.name: North (Hanoi, Ha Long Bay)
regions.shoulder: Jan-Mar (cool, misty; lows ~14 C), Jun, Sep
regions.avoid: Jul-Aug (hot, humid, rainy; Aug 359 mm in our data)
regions.reason: Vietnam Tourism: best Hanoi Apr-Jun or Sep-Dec; Ha Long Apr-Jun or Sep-Nov; storms can cancel cruises.

regions.name: Central (Da Nang, Hoi An, Hue)
regions.avoid: Sep-Dec (storms, floods; Oct 547 mm in our data)
regions.reason: Vietnam Tourism: Hoi An rainy Sep-Jan, tropical storms from Sep, small floods Sep-Nov.

regions.name: South (Ho Chi Minh City, Mekong)
regions.avoid: None
regions.reason: Vietnam Tourism: Dec-Apr clear and sunny; May-Nov wet season with a dependable afternoon downpour of a few hours.

regions.name: Phu Quoc
regions.avoid: Jul-Sep
regions.reason: Vietnam Tourism: avoid Jul-Sep (storms, ferry risk), Dec-Jan 'sublime'. Our data also show heavy rain in May-Jun and Oct (310-344 mm), so we rate those months okay, not best.

countries.notes: No single month suits the whole country; Vietnam Tourism says Mar-May is the best countrywide.
peaks: Tet (lunar new year) in early Feb 2027: [Inference] domestic travel peak, some closures.

regions.name: Kuala Lumpur & west coast
regions.avoid: None (Nov is wettest, 400 mm in our data)
regions.reason: MetMalaysia: most of the peninsula has rain peaks in Oct-Nov and Apr-May, with minima in Jun-Jul and Feb.

regions.name: Langkawi & Penang (northwest)
regions.avoid: Sep-Nov (244-327 mm in our data)
regions.reason: MetMalaysia: northwest primary rainfall minimum Jan-Feb, secondary minimum Jun-Jul, primary maximum Oct-Nov.

regions.name: East-coast islands (Perhentian, Redang, Tioman)
regions.avoid: Nov-Jan
regions.reason: MetMalaysia: NE monsoon (Nov-Mar) brings heavy rain, floods and rough seas to the east coast; Nov-Jan wettest, Jun-Jul driest.

countries.notes: No climate series fetched for the east-coast islands; ratings come from MetMalaysia text only.
peaks: Chinese New Year early Feb 2027; Hari Raya Aidilfitri ~10 Mar 2027 (Singapore date; Malaysia's own gazette may differ by a day).

regions.name: Bali
regions.shoulder: Apr, Oct; Nov-Mar wet (Jan-Feb wettest, ~370 mm in our data)
regions.avoid: None
regions.reason: Bali Provincial Govt: dry season generally Apr-Oct, rainy season Oct-Apr, with Oct and Apr as transition months.

countries.notes: Nyepi (Day of Silence) 8 Mar 2027: Bali's airport is expected to close for 24 hours, as in past years; check before booking.
peaks: Indian May-June school holidays fall in Bali's dry season.

regions.name: West & south coast, hill country (Colombo, Galle, Kandy)
regions.avoid: May, Oct-Nov (Colombo 359-400 mm in our data)
regions.reason: Tourism Sri Lanka: west, south and hill country best Dec-Mar. Met Dept: SW monsoon May-Sep wets the southwest; Oct-Nov inter-monsoon brings squalls and cyclones island-wide.

regions.name: East coast (Trincomalee, Arugam Bay)
regions.avoid: Nov-Dec (NE monsoon; Nov 404 mm in our data)
regions.reason: Met Dept: the NE monsoon (Dec-Feb) rains on the north and east; Tourism SL says the east coast is at its finest May-Sep.

countries.notes: The opposite coasts give Sri Lanka a good option in every month.
peaks: Indian May-June holidays suit the east coast and the Cultural Triangle, not the west-coast beaches.

regions.name: Male & central atolls
regions.avoid: None outright; May and Nov wettest in our data (~250 mm)
regions.reason: Maldives Met Service: dry NE monsoon Jan-Mar, wet SW monsoon mid-May-Nov, Dec and Apr transitional; thunderstorms most frequent in Apr; strong winds can disrupt ferries.

countries.notes: Southern atolls also get heavy showers in the NE monsoon (MMS).

regions.name: Paro, Thimphu, Punakha
regions.avoid: Jul-Aug (monsoon)
regions.reason: Bhutan DoT: monsoon late Jun/Jul to late Sep; Jun-Sep monsoons can disrupt transport (floods, landslides); autumn sunny, festive; winter crisp and clear.

countries.notes: Indians pay SDF of Nu 1,200 per person per night (bhutan.travel). Our ERA5 rainfall for Paro and Thimphu is implausibly high (see caveats); show temperatures only.
peaks: Paro Tshechu (spring; 29 Mar-2 Apr 2026, tentative); Thimphu Tshechu (21-23 Sep 2026, tentative). 2027 dates: check the DoT calendar.

regions.name: Kathmandu, Pokhara
regions.shoulder: Dec-Feb (cold nights, clear views), May, Sep
regions.avoid: Jun-Aug (monsoon; 80% of rain falls Jun-Sep)
regions.reason: Nepal Tourism Board: best in spring (rhododendrons) and autumn; clearest skies after the monsoon in Oct-Nov.

countries.notes: Our ERA5 rainfall for Nepal runs about 1.6x higher than NTB figures (Pokhara 5,490 vs 3,345 mm/yr). Use NTB/DHM figures for rain.
peaks: Dashain and Tihar (Oct-Nov; Tihar coincides with Diwali) [check annual dates].

regions.name: Tokyo, Osaka/Kyoto
regions.best: Late Mar-May (cherry blossom late Mar-early Apr), Oct-Nov (autumn leaves late Nov)
regions.avoid: Jun (tsuyu rainy season); also Golden Week (late Apr-early May) for crowds
regions.reason: JNTO: tsuyu runs through June (Hokkaido largely spared); most typhoons form Jul-Oct; Golden Week, Obon (mid-Aug) and New Year are domestic peaks with crowds and full transport.

countries.notes: Tokyo first bloom averages 24 Mar and Osaka 27 Mar (JNTO / Japan Weather Association).

regions.name: Seoul, Busan, Jeju
regions.shoulder: Mar, Nov (cold for most Indians; Seoul Nov 12/2 C), Jun, Aug, Dec-Feb (ski/snow; Seoul Jan -6 C lows)
regions.avoid: Jul (jangma rainy season; Seoul's wettest month, 282 mm in our data)
regions.reason: KTO: spring and fall are best for walking; rainy season late Jun-late Jul; Jun-Oct is typhoon season; winter averages 0-1 C.

peaks: Seollal 6-9 Feb 2027 and Chuseok 14-16 Sep 2027 (KASI): domestic travel peaks.
